# Before you begin {-}

![](images/ctt_logo.png){width=3in}

In order to connect directly to your SensorStation, you'll need 2 `USB->Ethernet Adapters` (we recommend: https://tinyurl.com/yc6llze4), and a Cat-6 Ethernet Cable.

::: {.version-v2 .version-v30 .version-v32}
**For V3.0, V3.2, and V2 boards**
If you are going to update the disk image, use a micro-USB to USB-A cable with data wires (we recommend: https://tinyurl.com/3hjp6brf). **Charging cables will not work!**

::: {.version-v33}
**For V3.3 boards**
If you are going to update the disk image, use a micro-USB to USB-A cable with data wires (we recommend: https://tinyurl.com/5h8cs99t). **Charging cables will not work!**

::: {.version-v2}
You'll also need a `Raspberry Pi compatible USB WiFi adapter` like this one https://store.celltracktech.com/products/wifi-usb-adapter-add-on-for-sensorstation-v2 if you want to connect via WiFi.
:::

::: {.version-v33 .version-v32 .version-v30}
The WiFi is pre-installed on the board -- no extra adapter needed.
:::

**Make sure to have these on-hand prior to receiving your SensorStation so there is no delay in setup.**
